alt.en: A printed page of music for voice and piano, headed "To Miss Emma F. Tolen." and "You're the Flower of My Heart, Sweet Adeline", with "Words by Richard H. Gerard." and "Music by Harry Armstrong." It is marked "Andante (Slowly, with expression)", in B-flat and common time, with two verses under the notes, beginning "In the evening when I sit alone a-dreaming" and "I can see your smiling face as when we wandered". At the foot: "M.W.& Sons 6003 - 4", "Copyright MCMIII by M. Witmark & Sons", "Copyright Renewed", "International Copyright Secured", "Made in U.S.A.", "All rights reserved including public performance for profit", a warning against unauthorised arrangements, and a small boxed "UPB".
alt.es: Una página impresa de música para voz y piano, con el encabezado "To Miss Emma F. Tolen." y "You're the Flower of My Heart, Sweet Adeline", con "Words by Richard H. Gerard." y "Music by Harry Armstrong.". Está marcada "Andante (Slowly, with expression)", en Si bemol y en compás de cuatro por cuatro, con dos estrofas bajo las notas, que empiezan "In the evening when I sit alone a-dreaming" y "I can see your smiling face as when we wandered". Al pie: "M.W.& Sons 6003 - 4", "Copyright MCMIII by M. Witmark & Sons", "Copyright Renewed", "International Copyright Secured", "Made in U.S.A.", "All rights reserved including public performance for profit", un aviso contra los arreglos no autorizados y un pequeño recuadro con "UPB".

caption.en: The first page of music in a later Witmark printing of the 1903 song, marked "Copyright Renewed", with the same plate number, 6003, as the copy our melody is read from: the dedication "To Miss Emma F. Tolen" sits above the 1903 copyright notice.
caption.es: La primera página de música de una impresión posterior de Witmark de la canción de 1903, marcada "Copyright Renewed" (copyright renovado), con el mismo número de plancha, 6003, que el ejemplar del que está leída nuestra melodía: la dedicatoria "To Miss Emma F. Tolen" está sobre el aviso de copyright de 1903.

source: Richard H. Gerard and Harry Armstrong, You're the Flower of My Heart, Sweet Adeline, ballad (New York: M. Witmark & Sons, Black and White Series; a later printing marked "Copyright Renewed"), page 2

The page holds only Gerard's words (he died 1948) and Armstrong's music (he died 1951) and the publisher's notices; life + 70 ended 2021, so public domain in the EU and Israel. No text or music by anyone else. Faithful scan of a flat page (see rights.md).

alt.en: A printed page of music for voice and piano, headed "Refrain", marked "a tempo" and "mf espressivo", with the words "Sweet Adeline, My Adeline, At night, dear heart, For you I pine; In all my dreams Your fair face beams, You're the flower of my heart, Sweet Adeline." The voice holds long notes, tied across the bar lines, while the piano moves in short runs beneath them; the last bars carry pause marks and "rit." and "D.C.". At the foot: "M.W.& Sons 6003 - 4" and a boxed warning: "Any copying of the words or music of this song, or any portion thereof, makes the infringer liable to criminal prosecution under the U.S. copyright law."
alt.es: Una página impresa de música para voz y piano, con el encabezado "Refrain", marcada "a tempo" y "mf espressivo", con la letra "Sweet Adeline, My Adeline, At night, dear heart, For you I pine; In all my dreams Your fair face beams, You're the flower of my heart, Sweet Adeline.". La voz mantiene notas largas, ligadas por encima de las barras de compás, mientras el piano se mueve debajo con breves pasajes; los últimos compases llevan calderones, "rit." y "D.C.". Al pie: "M.W.& Sons 6003 - 4" y un aviso enmarcado: "Any copying of the words or music of this song, or any portion thereof, makes the infringer liable to criminal prosecution under the U.S. copyright law."

caption.en: The printed refrain in the same later Witmark printing of the 1903 song, from plate 6003: each short line ends on a long held note while the piano fills the gap beneath it, the gaps that quartets fill with answering voices.
caption.es: El estribillo impreso en la misma impresión posterior de Witmark de la canción de 1903, de la plancha 6003: cada verso corto termina en una nota larga mantenida mientras el piano llena el hueco debajo, los huecos que los cuartetos llenan con voces que responden.

Below is a price list headed "Published for the following arrangements": Solo, Duet, Waltz, 2 Part Treble (SA), 3 Part Treble (SSA), 3 Part Mixed (SAB), 4 Part Mixed (SATB), 4 Part Female (SSAA), 4 Part Male (TTBB), Vocal Orchestration in B-flat, Small Orchestra (Waltz Medley), Full Orchestra (Waltz Medley) and Band. Debajo hay una lista de precios con el encabezado "Published for the following arrangements": Solo, Duet, Waltz, 2 Part Treble (SA), 3 Part Treble (SSA), 3 Part Mixed (SAB), 4 Part Mixed (SATB), 4 Part Female (SSAA), 4 Part Male (TTBB), Vocal Orchestration en Si bemol, Small Orchestra (Waltz Medley), Full Orchestra (Waltz Medley) y Band.
